page_title: GET 2-1 ALM | Getafe v Almeria 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' The free kick from long range, taken by Almeria, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+2' Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game. One of the players from Getafe won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Fabrizio Angileri (Getafe) replaces Mason Greenwood.
89' Substitution. Borja Mayoral walks off the pitch and Jaime Mata (Getafe) comes on as a substitute.
87' The Almeria players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
84' It is time for a substitution. Arnau Puigmal (Almeria) is on for Sergio Arribas.
83' Gaizka Garitano has decided to substitute Largie Ramazani and he is replaced by Marciano Sanca (Almeria).
82' Surely that's handball by one of the Getafe players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
82' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Almeria will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
79' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) jumps above the defenders in order to convert a lofted cross with a nice header. David Soria makes a reflexive save to block his effort from hitting the net.
78' Almeria will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
75' Gaizka Garitano prepares a substitution. Lucas Robertone is replaced by Gonzalo Melero (Almeria).
74' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) takes the corner with a short pass.
72' Carles Alena (Getafe) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Juanmi Latasa.
69' The attendance for today's match is 10906.
68' Gaizka Garitano decides to make a substitution. Houboulang Mendes will be replaced by Alejandro Pozo (Almeria).
67' Here comes a substitution. Lazaro (Almeria) is brought on as a substitute for Adrian Embarba.
64' Yellow card. Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
63' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) gets booked for the first time in this match.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Leo Baptistao (Almeria) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' A pass into the box finds Borja Mayoral (Getafe) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Luis Maximiano denies him.
57' It should have been a goal! Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
56' 3:3 – the corner kicks stats.
55' Almeria are ruled offside.
52' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) for his blatant foul.
52' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Almeria was in an offside position.
50' Almeria have a free kick.
50' Getafe concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
48' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Omar Alderete comes off for Djene (Getafe).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' 2 - 1 Goal! Borja Mayoral (Getafe) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
42' Getafe get a corner.
40' A quickly taken corner by Getafe.
39' A corner kick by Almeria is thwarted by the well prepared David Soria (Getafe).
35' Alejandro Hernandez sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
35' Wait! Referee Alejandro Hernandez has indicated he is going to review the Getafe goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

33' 1 - 1 A good lofted pass from Omar Alderete finds Mason Greenwood (Getafe) on the edge of the area. He collects the ball and rips in a wonderful shot which ends up in the top left corner. The score is now 1:1.
30' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Almeria.
30' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) replaces Jose Angel Carmona.
30' Jose Bordalas Jimenez isn't happy on the touchline after referee Alejandro Hernandez shows him a yellow card.
28' Omar Alderete (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.

26' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
24' Diego Rico (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
23' Getafe have a corner.

23' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Luis Maximiano!
22' The rebound finds Leo Baptistao (Almeria) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance! The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
21' The current number of offsides is 0:3.
20' One of the players from Almeria times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
19' A player from Almeria commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
16' The linesman raises his flag. Largie Ramazani (Almeria) is adjudged offside.
11' Getafe control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
8' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Largie Ramazani (Almeria) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Chumi knock down. 0:1.
7' The ball goes out of play. Almeria are awarded a corner kick.
3' A brilliant cross into the box finds Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
2' Almeria are ruled offside.
1' The match has just started.
Almeria will kick-off.
